listings.remarks: This adorable single-story home is the one for you! Nestled in a desirable golf-course corner lot, this gem offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a 2-car garage. Inside, you'll discover sizable living areas perfect for entertaining and relaxation, including a formal dining room. The kitchen comes equipped with ample counters, plenty of cabinet space, essential appliances, and a pantry. The main bedroom hosts a walk-in closet for easy organization and a full bathroom for added comfort. The backyard includes a covered patio ideal for enjoying a refreshing drink. Hurry up and check it out!
highlights: Single story on a golf-course corner lot
2-car garage with cabinets and golf cart garage
Sun City amenities: pool, rec center, golf

listings.remarks: PREMIUM PARK-FACING LOT with stunning Estrella and South Mountain views, no homes directly in front, beautiful evening scenery, and OWNED SOLAR! Welcome to 5442 W Samantha Way in Laveen Commons! Enjoy nearby pickleball, volleyball, parks, shopping, dining, and convenient Loop 202 access for commuting to Downtown Phoenix and employment centers. This 3-bed, 2-bath home features a split 3-car garage, RV gate and parking, high ceilings, great room, formal dining, and den. The kitchen offers granite counters, SS appliances, island, and pantry. Spacious primary suite with dual sinks, separate tub/shower, and walk-in closet. Relax in the low-maintenance backyard with covered patio, flagstone, and turf. Scenic surroundings meet everyday convenience!
highlights: Park-facing lot with Estrella and South Mountain views
Split 3-car garage plus RV gate and parking
Den, great room and formal dining
Low-maintenance backyard with covered patio and turf
